useCase.name: Contact the families on the overdue list and prompt them to pay

intent.name: fee.reminder.send
intent.summary: Send fee reminders to families on the overdue list, each carrying their own amount and due date, and log every send against the student. One step.
routesHere: send a reminder to everyone overdue in Grade 4

A reminder changes nothing. It does not charge a late fee, alter the invoice or extend the due date (BR-10).

routesElsewhere.note: This is the fee reminder path, and only Accounts use it (BR-1).
A reminder does not extend a due date, and nothing in this use case does (BR-10).

steps.note: One step, whether the request names one family or ninety. Each family's own amount outstanding and due date are filled from their invoice (BR-2) — the plan supplies no figure.

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Missing contacts, unresolved merge fields, the authorisation threshold and messaging balance are all enforced by the API and arrive as errors. A send above the threshold is not refused — it is held for School Admin authorisation (E4), which is an outcome to report.
plan.atomicity: One write per recipient, and the batch does not stop at the first failure: valid recipients are sent and failures are listed. Each send writes a reminder log entry against the student with the amount outstanding at the moment of sending (BR-9), so a message quoting PKR 4,000 stays explicable after the family pays part of it. Delivery status starts at Queued and is never reported optimistically (BR-8) — a run that reports success has queued the reminders, not delivered them. Nothing about the invoice changes (BR-10).

operations.name: fee.reminder.send
operations.idempotencyKey: student_ids + template_id + channel + the send timestamp, so a repeat does not message the same families twice and inflate the reminder history BR-12 reads
operations.purpose: Send a templated fee reminder to selected families, resolving each family's own figures, and log every send against the student.

parameters.name: student_ids

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No overdue student matches, or none holding a contact for that channel.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates. For a set, report how many and who before anything is sent — a reminder cannot be unsent.

parameters.notes: The families to remind, drawn from the overdue list. Families meeting an approved installment plan are excluded and cannot be re-added by selecting all (BR-3); a family who has missed an installment is not excluded (BR-4).

parameters.name: channel
parameters.notes: Only channels the student record holds a contact for are offered (BR-5).

parameters.name: template_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No reminder template of that name for this channel.

parameters.notes: A saved reminder template. Required for a send to more than one family (BR-6, E3). Omit only for a single family written to directly.

parameters.name: message_body
parameters.notes: Maximum 1000 characters, for one family only. Never for several — free text to many cannot be reviewed before it goes or reused after (BR-6).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: sent
fields.description: student_id, reminder_id, outstanding_at_send, delivery_status. Queued until the provider says otherwise (BR-8).

fields.name: excluded_on_plan
fields.description: Families meeting an approved plan, kept out of the send (BR-3).

fields.name: excluded_paid
fields.description: Families who paid since the list was run (E6). Not chased.

fields.name: no_contact
fields.description: Families holding no contact for the channel (E1).

fields.name: recently_reminded
fields.description: Families reminded within the configured interval, flagged so the same family is not messaged three times in a week (BR-12).

fields.name: awaiting_authorisation
fields.description: True where the selection exceeded the threshold. Nothing has been sent (BR-7).

errors.meaning: Some selected students hold no contact for any channel.
errors.note: Listed. Adding a contact is a correction to the student record (UC-03-01).

errors.meaning: A template field cannot be filled for a family.
errors.note: The send is blocked rather than going out with a gap where the amount should be. Never fill it in by hand (BR-2).

errors.meaning: A multi-family send was attempted with free text.
The selection is above the threshold.
errors.written: The send is queued and School Admin is notified.
errors.note: Not a failure. Never split the selection to get under the threshold.

errors.meaning: There is no messaging balance for the channel.
errors.note: Never fall back to another channel — the family may hold no contact for it (BR-5).

errors.meaning: Some selected families have paid since the list was run.
errors.note: Listed and skipped. A family who paid this morning is not chased this afternoon (UC-04-06 BR-5).

errors.meaning: A Staff user attempted to send a reminder.
errors.note: Only Accounts send fee reminders (BR-1). In practice the capability is absent from a Staff allow-list.
Report them as queued, never as sent (BR-8).

planningRules.rule: Report what a set resolves to before anything is sent, with the count and the total outstanding. A reminder cannot be unsent, and "sab ko bhej do" is a phrase with no number in it.

Never supply an amount or a due date into a message. Each reminder carries that family's own figures, filled from their invoice — a figure typed into a message is a figure that can be wrong (BR-2), and it is the number the family will act on.

Never include families meeting an approved plan. They are excluded by the API and cannot be re-added by selecting all (BR-3); a family paying as agreed being chased is the failure that rule exists to prevent.
Never split a selection to get under the authorisation threshold. It exists so a School Admin sees a large chase before it goes (BR-7).
Never switch channel because one has no balance or no contact. The channel was chosen, and a family who gave a number and no email is not reachable by email (BR-5).

Report reminders as queued, never as delivered, and report the recently-reminded flag. The school believing a family was told when they were not is what BR-8 prevents, and messaging the same family three times in a week is what BR-12 prevents.
Never claim a reminder does anything to the debt. It charges no late fee, alters no invoice and extends no due date (BR-10).

reversal.statement: A reminder cannot be unsent. The log entry, the amount held against it and the delivery status are history. Where the wrong families were chased, the answer is an apology somebody sends, not a compensating call.
